title: OSV evidence validation did not require complete vulnerability-group coverage
summary: OSV comparison evidence could be valid JSON while omitting, duplicating, or inconsistently grouping vulnerability IDs.
summary_de: OSV-Vergleichs-Evidence konnte gültiges JSON sein und trotzdem Schwachstellen-IDs auslassen, duplizieren oder inkonsistent gruppieren.
observed_behavior: The original evidence contract did not prove complete non-overlapping group coverage.
observed_behavior_de: Der ursprüngliche Evidence-Contract bewies keine vollständige nicht überlappende Gruppenabdeckung.
expected_behavior: Every reported ID must be represented exactly once in validated groups and evidence paths must be trusted bounded regular files.
expected_behavior_de: Jede berichtete ID muss genau einmal in validierten Gruppen repräsentiert sein und Evidence-Pfade müssen vertrauenswürdige begrenzte Regular Files sein.
impact: A malformed comparison could understate newly introduced dependency vulnerabilities.
impact_de: Ein fehlerhafter Vergleich könnte neu eingeführte Abhängigkeitsschwachstellen unterberichten.
acceptance_criteria: Complete non-overlapping validated group coverage is required.
Malformed and untrusted evidence fails closed.
Exact final PR-head OSV CI verifies the result.
validation_plan: Run OSV evidence-contract unit tests and make lint.
Observe the exact final PR-head OSV workflow after the OSV service is available.

evidence.command: rtk make test-ci-security-contract; rtk make lint

root_cause: Schema validation and comparison grouping did not initially require complete non-overlapping coverage.
root_cause_de: Schema-Validierung und Vergleichsgruppierung verlangten anfänglich keine vollständige nicht überlappende Abdeckung.
proposed_remediation: Implemented strict schema/group validation, alias-aware comparison, and runner-root evidence confinement.
proposed_remediation_de: Strikte Schema-/Gruppenvalidierung, Alias-bewussten Vergleich und Runner-Root-Evidence-Containment implementiert.
legitimate_control_tests: Alias-equivalent vulnerability enrichment is accepted as non-new.
residual_risk: Local remediation remains fixed, but exact PR #50 head verification is blocked externally: OSV Scanner reported service unavailable while resolving the unchanged trusted base manifest, so no trustworthy comparison output exists. The workflow must remain fail-closed; a fresh hosted run is required after service recovery.
residual_risk_de: Die lokale Remediation bleibt behoben, aber die Exact-Head-Verifikation von PR #50 ist extern blockiert: Der OSV-Scanner meldete beim Auflösen des unveränderten Trusted-Base-Manifests service unavailable, daher existiert kein vertrauenswürdiges Vergleichsergebnis. Der Workflow muss fail-closed bleiben; nach Service-Recovery ist ein frischer Hosted-Run erforderlich.

history.detail: Strict group coverage and evidence-path controls are committed in 768a06b and locally validated.

Exact PR #50 head b0f3e745075d57ee727bdfcd61f6258d488d4dc1 reached the bounded base/head comparison, but OSV Scanner returned service unavailable for the unchanged base requirements-dev.txt. The job exited 127 before trustworthy comparison evidence existed; no workflow, dependency, or security-control weakening was applied.
